status: prospective reservation; not a claim of completed collection or locked-test results
raw_collection_manifests: Preserved unchanged. The following parent mapping is applied only to separate derived exports.
parent_rule: All trajectories, views, language variants and constraint variants of one parent inherit its role.

existing_development.natural: derived_reach_261024 through derived_reach_261031 remain reused DEV_MODEL
existing_development.obstacle: obstacle_reach_271100 through obstacle_reach_271103 remain reused DEV_MODEL

OOD_LOCKED.rule: Requires a genuinely changed layout/task/observation distribution declared before inspection; do not relabel IID parents as OOD.

access_policy.development_exports: Contain only explicitly requested nonlocked parent roles. Never train or evaluate directly on the entire raw collector directory.
access_policy.TEST_LOCKED: No image, target, trajectory, per-scene result or aggregate model metric may be inspected for method selection. Export separately after closure; open only under a frozen final evaluation protocol.
access_policy.DEV_SCORE: Reserved for scorer development, not generator method selection.
access_policy.CALIBRATION: Reserved for fitting calibration after fixing generator and scorer configurations.
access_policy.collection_audits: Mechanical state-restore/format/hash audits and total collection failure bookkeeping are allowed without model-based selection or replacing failed parents.
access_policy.failures: Keep each requested parent in its assigned role; never replace it with a later successful parent.
